context_requirements: Expression of cardiac ion channels (e.g., KCNA5, KCNH2) or beta-adrenergic receptors (ADRB1/ADRB2) at sufficient levels
Electrically excitable or adrenergically responsive cell context; most immortalized cancer lines lack this
For beta-blocker subclass: ADRB2 expression, which is low in most of these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Enrichment of adrenergic or ion-channel transcriptional signatures after treatment
Consistent up- or down-regulation of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) across multiple lines

evidence.supports: Antiarrhythmic drug effects are mediated by modulation of cardiac ion channels and depend on atrial transcription factor context (PITX2), not by broad transcriptional reprogramming in non-cardiac cells.
Antiarrhythmic mechanisms involve ion channel and calcium-handling protein function rather than acute transcriptional changes in typical cell lines.
